question: Which Indian city will host the 5th Coast Guard Global Summit (CGGS) in 2027?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chennai.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India will host the 5th Coast Guard Global Summit (CGGS) in Chennai in 2027.**
 
• **The event will coincide with the Golden Jubilee celebrations of the Indian Coast Guard (ICG).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chennai will host the 5th Coast Guard Global Summit (CGGS) in 2027, aligning with the Golden Jubilee of the Indian Coast Guard.**
 
• The summit will feature an International Coast Guard Fleet Review and a World Coast Guard Seminar, focusing on emerging maritime challenges.
 
• The decision to host the summit in Chennai was made unanimously during the 4th CGGS held in Rome in September 2025.
 
• The summit will provide a global platform for fostering cooperation and addressing shared maritime challenges among Coast Guards worldwide.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Indian Coast Guard (ICG)__

 __
 
• A multi-mission organization tasked with maritime security, environmental protection, and search and rescue operations in Indian waters.
 
 
 
• Maritime Search and Rescue (M-SAR)__
 __
 
• International efforts for coordinated search and rescue operations in maritime regions, highlighted during the India–Italy discussions.
 
 
 
• CGGS (Coast Guard Global Summit)__
 
 
• An international summit for global Coast Guard cooperation, addressing maritime security, environmental protection, and transnational maritime crimes.
